Kerala seeks more central aid for power and cooperatives

Kerala's cooperative sector and electricity supply are facing challenges, prompting state ministers to seek increased support from the central government. The state highlighted the need for greater central assistance for its cooperative sector and requested an extended power allocation to address an electricity crunch. These requests underscore ongoing issues with resource allocation and support for key state sectors.
